# Copilot instructions

The authoritative AI-assistant guidance for this repository is
[`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root. Read it before making any
change here — it covers the architecture (two containers; three
orchestration paths: WSL dev, Codespaces dev, RHEL production, plus a WSL
production rehearsal path), secrets handling, the `postgis` adapter
requirement, config templating, plugin/theme pinning, shell script
conventions, documentation/language conventions, and the verification
workflow.

This file intentionally does not restate that content. If you are about to
add or change guidance, edit `CLAUDE.md` (the source of truth) and leave this
file as a pointer to it.
